title: CROSSAGENTIE: Cross-Type and Cross-Task Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration for Zero-Shot Information Extraction

layout.note: Three titled columns: a left spine (input, black-box collaboration, output table, inference heading) that turns into a bottom inference row; a middle rounded container stacking three dashed stage boxes with block arrows; and at right three dashed detail panels in the stage colours, each fed by a light-blue magnifier arrow from its stage; a black line labelled Template Fine-Tuning crosses from the output table to the LLM box.

lesson: Zoom a multi-stage method in three columns: the whole process, its stage boxes, then one detail panel per stage; give each stage one colour that returns on its panel, join them with magnifier arrows and run one tiny example through the details.
